prompts.name: hands-fixed
prompts.prompt: Edit this Autoloot cover. Preserve the entire layout, lettering, colors, character identity, outfit, auction illustration and 3:2 1536x1024 canvas. Correct ONLY both hands to anatomically correct human anime hands with exactly five digits each: one thumb and four fingers. On the open presenting hand at center, show four distinct natural fingers together plus one thumb. On the pointing hand at right, show one raised index finger, three naturally folded fingers and one thumb. Clear elegant anatomy, no extra digits or fused fingers. Keep all other art unchanged.

prompts.name: 02-editorial
prompts.prompt:
Create a professional Autoloot project submission cover. EXACT 3:2 landscape 1536x1024. Reference image is character identity reference only: Munny, friendly anime cat-eared woman with charcoal bob, lime hoodie, black top, orange headphones and pouch. Preserve identity and polished clean ink illustration. Brand palette warm cream #f3efdf, charcoal #252823, sage #e6e8d8, lime #d2ee64, restrained orange #ed844f. Large perfectly legible rounded lowercase wordmark "autoloot". Exact tagline "Your stream. Your shop. Your pace." No third party logos, watermark or nonsense microtext. Confident hierarchy and generous spacing, readable as submission thumbnail. Any visible hand MUST be anatomically correct with exactly five digits: four fingers plus a thumb.
Minimal editorial poster composition. Cream background. Huge wordmark across upper area, tagline below. Munny chest-up at lower right behind a large rounded sage auction dashboard, BOTH HANDS COMPLETELY OUT OF FRAME behind the panel. The panel spans lower left, original collectible star-creature trading card, "LIVE", "$48", three simple chat bubbles. Elegant flat shapes, lime disk and restrained orange sparkle. More quiet negative space, crisp thick outlines, no tilted panels.
